requirement.normalizedRequirement: For transversely-framed plating (Omega >= 70 deg), including bottom plating in hull areas BI_b, M_b and S_b, t_net = 500*s*sqrt((AF*PPF_p*P_avg)/sigma_y)/(1 + s/(2*b)) [mm].
requirement.source: UR I2 Structural Requirements for Polar Class Ships
requirement.sourceText: In the case of transversely-framed plating (Omega >= 70 deg), including all bottom plating in hull areas BI_b, M_b and S_b, the net thickness is given by t_net = 500*s*sqrt((AF*PPF_p*P_avg)/sigma_y)/(1 + s/(2*b)) [mm].
